svg.title: Zane Wang — building tools that make AI coding agents more reliable
svg.desc: A pixel-art sunset over a city drawn from the past year of Zane's GitHub contributions: one building per week, one window per day, lit on the 298 days he contributed, and a gold pennant over each week in which one of his pull requests was merged upstream. Below the city: 12 PRs merged into 10 upstream projects (Apr – Aug 2026), 10 bug fixes and 2 small features. Two of them: SQLx #4340, pre-1970 SQLite datetimes are no longer off by up to 2 seconds; AnyIO #1223, CapacityLimiter no longer grants more tokens than it has. Also merged: axum, goose, Fastify, Zod, TanStack Query, Tenacity, Feast and Claude HUD (three). His production background covers multimodal evaluation and data systems; his current public focus is tools for reliable AI coding agents: claudemem, handoff and dev-orchestrator.
